tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a YouTube video from its link. Returns the captions YouTube has for the video (subtitles uploaded by the creator, or the auto-generated captions) as plain text, with the title, channel and the caption languages available. Does not work for videos without captions, or for private, members-only or age-restricted videos.

language.description: Language code of the captions to return, for example en, es or pt-BR. Defaults to the language spoken in the video.

timestamps.description: Prefix every caption line with its start time, like [1:23]. Defaults to false.

url.description: Link to a single YouTube video, for example https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ

tools.name: transcribe_tiktok_video
tools.description: Transcribe the speech in a TikTok video to text from its link. The spoken language is detected automatically. Usually takes 20 to 60 seconds. Free use is limited per day and per video length; if the transcription is not finished when this call returns, it gives a job_id for get_transcription_result.

timestamps.description: Prefix every line with its start time, like [0:12]. Defaults to false.

url.description: Link to a TikTok video, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/7300000000000000000 or a vm.tiktok.com share link.

tools.name: get_transcription_result
tools.description: Get the result of a transcription that transcribe_tiktok_video started but did not finish in time. Pass the job_id that call returned.

timestamps.description: Prefix every line with its start time, like [0:12]. Defaults to false.
